name: B10-0337/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission delegated regulation of 10 April 2026 amending Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/807 to introduce a trajectory to gradually decrease the contribution of high indirect land-use change-risk biofuels, bioliquids and biomass fuels to renewable energy targets
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a European Commission plan that would label soybean-based biodiesel as a high-risk fuel for deforestation and phase it out of EU renewable energy targets by 2030. Parliament says the science behind the soybean label is flawed: it uses the wrong start year, ignores double-cropping, and misjudges Brazil's Cerrado savanna. It also warns of harm to EU farmers, feed supplies and protein independence. Parliament accepts the palm oil phase-down.

- The Commission must withdraw the soybean rule and propose a corrected version.
- EU soy farmers, crushers and biodiesel producers would avoid losses; palm oil phase-down stays.
- The Commission must submit a revised act; the current one cannot enter into force.
